verdict.rationale: Belvo is API-first: it is driven programmatically with API keys, and its async workflows and recurrent links refresh data in the background without a UI. A full-API sandbox exists for testing, which a CI pipeline could target. However, nothing documents headless or CI usage as such: no CLI, no CI integration guide and no non-interactive test tooling. The Connect Widget also implies an interactive step for end users. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration documentation, documented non-interactive link creation for automated test pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
